message:
emily: Heads-up: BlueLedger (payments reconciliation) wants to swap PromptCloud -> Redwood with zero-app changes. They asked for a 3-week POC: sandbox + staging run.
raj: Key asks from their infra lead: identical response fields, deterministic replays for billing audits, same 429/timeout semantics, and PCI-scoped logs retention. Any blockers?
sofia: We can do a compatibility proxy. Main items: path/body mapping, response renormalizer, deterministic seed support, header-based rate-limit passthrough, and an error-mapping table.
pete: Their current client hits POST /api/v1/prompt with body {"q":"...","maxTokens":200,"meta":{}} and expects {"result":"...","cost_cents":123}. Need sample mapping.
sofia: Example mapping (pseudo):
```
# PromptCloud -> Redwood mapping (pseudo)
POST /api/v1/prompt  {"q":"...", "maxTokens":200, "meta":{}}
-> POST /v1/outputs  {"input":"...", "options":{"max_tokens":200, "seed": <seed>}}
# Response map: {"result":"...", "cost_cents":123} -> {"output":[{"content":"..."}], "usage":{"input_tokens":X,"output_tokens":Y}}
```
claire: Watch token accounting differences. PromptCloud bills prompt+response; Redwood returns usage object but our hosted pricing brackets/rounding differ. Sales needs a delta example for 5k daily calls (median 60 in / 140 out).
emily: Also BlueLedger requires BYOK (KMS), VPC peering to their AWS account, and audit export to their SIEM. Those are gating for POC.
raj: Current readiness: BYOK available for Dedicated/Private; VPC peering supported for Private; syslog/SIEM exports exist for Dedicated + Private. Hosted offering needs legal/infra approval for BYOK.
sofia: For determinism: lock model version + provide seed + deterministic sampling params. Note: quantized model variants may still differ bitwise; document this in runbook. Add a set of golden replays (50 prompts) to validate parity.
pete: Failure modes: PromptCloud returns 504 for server timeouts; our stack returns 503 occasionally. We should map statuses and include a header so client sees the original shape.
sofia: I'll implement an error-mapper that rewrites Redwood responses into PromptCloud shapes and copies retry-after headers. Also include a feature-flagged rollback route to re-forward to PromptCloud.
infra-bot: infra-bot: sandbox cluster for blueledger-poc created in us-east-1 (cluster: rwd-sbx-19734). Access: sales, eng, security.
claire: Legal: they asked for DPA + subprocessors before starting. Lee from legal will need the customer email and SOW. I'll queue it.
emily: Sales asks for a 1-page cost delta: show modeled monthly diff for 5k/day, assumptions: p95 tokens, batching 16, quantized model option. Raj, can you and Sofia produce this by EOD tomorrow?
raj: Yes — will include two scenarios: Hosted (no BYOK) and Dedicated (pinned pool). Include a note on commit pricing if they want steady-state.
sofia: I'll also add a short parity test harness repo (Docker proxy + replay runner) and a checklist:
- Answer sec questionnaire + DPA signed
- Deploy sandbox proxy and run 50 golden replays
- Confirm BYOK/VPC path or Dedicated allocation
- Produce pricing delta + POC estimate
- Provide rollback toggle to original endpoints
claire: Security flags to check: PCI scope for logs, key separation if they want BYOK (no shared cache keys), retention window, and SOC2 attestation for the environment.
emily: Good. Timeline: sofia -> initial shim + repo in 3 days; raj -> pricing + runbook tomorrow; legal -> DPA sign queue; security -> sign-off during week 2. Kickoff with BlueLedger Wednesday 10am ET.
pete: Quick note on monitoring: add token-level cost reporting in the proxy logs, and expose a /metrics endpoint for Prometheus.
sofia: Will do. Also adding a reproducibility endpoint that returns the seed + model version used for each response. That helps audits.
emily: Nice. Backfill owners: sofia (proxy + tests), raj (pricing + capacity), claire (legal/security liaison), pete (metrics + rollback). I'll be primary POC.
emily: Thanks all — I'll update after the shim PR and the pricing sheet. :white_check_mark:
